title: AUTH-112 fresh login acquires distinct recovery

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given User A completed logout; the previous SESSION-A and refresh R-A are recorded

steps.title: Install clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 07:59:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
Pause clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 08:00:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 2. And the LOCAL login page is visible in the same isolated browser context
3. And the credential fixture accepts user-a / FixturePass1! with new SESSION-B and workspace WS-A
4. When User A enters "user-a" into the textbox with placeholder "Enter Username" on the login page
5. And User A enters "FixturePass1!" into the text input with placeholder "Enter Password" on the login page
6. And User A clicks the button labelled "Sign In" on the login page
7. Then the tab labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page is visible

steps.title: One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".

assertionSteps.title: 8. When the browser changes this page from visible to hidden
9. Then the acquisition POST body uses the new SESSION-B access credential
10. When the fixture accepts acquisition for SESSION-B
11. Then the installed refresh credential belongs to SESSION-B and differs from R-A

annotations.description: Actual MFE; controlled identity, catalog, API responses and browser time. Signed current-BFF validation is used only where declared. Synthetic credentials and user aliases; no real identity provider acceptance.
